# ANALYSIS: 3DTE_EXTENSION_VALIDATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extending the DTE from 0DTE to 3DTE may improve edge capture on J's anchor days by reducing theta decay and allowing the trade to survive intraday noise, while preserving the directional edge observed in the 0DTE BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup.

## Mechanism

1. **Stage-1 backtest:** Run the existing BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON logic with DTE=3 (same strike selection ITM-2, same entry/exit rules) over the full 16-month OPRA cache to generate a baseline equity curve and per-trade P&L.
2. **Walk-forward OOS:** Perform a walk-forward analysis (e.g., 12-month train, 4-month test, rolling) to compute out-of-sample Sharpe and edge_capture on the J anchor days.
3. **Real-fills validation:** Replay the top 3 J winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) through the realistic OPRA simulator (real bid/ask, slippage model) to compare BS-sim vs real-fills P&L; require diff < ±20% for each day.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L scaling.
2. **Sample bias:** Using J's 6 anchor days (3 winners, 3 losers) as source-of-truth; small sample size (n=6) high overfit risk; walk-forward OOS will test on unseen periods.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not yet validated with realistic OPRA simulator).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/07 loser 2 (-$120); max drawdown scenario: adverse VIX regime causing repeated stops; blow-up scenario: gap through chart stop on high-vol day.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if top-5 days = X% of P&L, will disclose X).

## Pre-merge gate

- Stage-1 backtest must pass gym validators (81/81) and produce edge_capture > 0 on J winners.
- Walk-forward OOS must achieve WF ratio ≥ 0.70 and sub-window stability (no more than 1 negative quarter).
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days must show BS-sim vs real-fills diff < ±20% for each day.
- Anchor no-regression: edge_capture on J winners must not decrease vs baseline 0DTE engine.
